source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The May 2024 nsIMsgDBHdr change replaces raw IDL string fields such as messageId, author, recipients, ccList and bccList with AUTF8String. It avoids raw char pointer ownership at C++ and Rust boundaries. A reviewer requested the same for charset and accountKey; that follow-up landed in February 2025. Do not rely on the original claim that every raw header is ASCII: RFC 6532 permits raw UTF-8.
title: Use XPCOM string types for message header interface fields
